overall_reason: The preferences card is untinted greys with one sage #6e8474 on the switch's on state and a #333333 'Save preferences' fill, but the white card sits inside a thick #eaeaea frame.

score.reason: T-PALETTE-ROLES and T-ACCENT-DOSAGE pass, but T-SURFACE-LADDER finds a box in a well: a white card inside a grey ring that separates nothing.

findings.title: Regions use the lowest rung of the surface ladder
findings.evidence: The tile shows the white card inset about 12px inside a #eaeaea rounded frame (0.8% of the area at 1440, 3.5% at 375); the frame holds only this one card.
findings.before: White card inside a #eaeaea ring, two surfaces for one group
findings.after: One rung: the card on the page ground with a hairline edge, or the tinted well alone with no inner card
findings.why: Two surfaces for one group spend contrast on framing; deleting the ring loses nothing.

strengths: The sage #6e8474 marks only the switch's on state.
The primary action is in ink (#333333), so the one hue is kept for state.
not_investigated: Brand authority: the run has no 00-contract.md, so no brand colours or design system were available; T-COLOUR-SOURCE was judged from the composition alone, and the visitor mode was taken as Operate (a product UI component).
T-DARK-MODE: the stylesheet ships a dark class theme, but the capture rendered only the light scheme, so dark mode is not verified.
T-GRADIENT-STOPS and contrast: owned by the sweep (A11-001); small-text contrast hits are not restated here.
